mufasa.name: Mufasa
mufasa.oneLiner: AI fitness coach built for Indian diets and budgets.
mufasa.text: Generates personalised workout and meal plans from body type, veg/egg/non-veg/vegan preference, budget and activity. Macros are computed deterministically (Mifflin-St Jeor → TDEE) and Gemini output is validated against them before saving. Plans regenerate only on profile edits to keep API costs down.
mufasa.log: release(pwa): Mufasa AI fitness coach — live
mufasa.logSub: Gemini plans validated against deterministic macros · May 2026

NotchIsland.oneLiner: A free, open-source Dynamic Island for the MacBook notch.
NotchIsland.text: Hover the notch for system-wide now-playing, picture-in-picture for calls and browser video that survives Space switches, AirDrop by drop, clipboard history, audio switching and call detection that needs no permissions. Every permission is requested lazily, only when a feature first runs.
NotchIsland.logSub: Native Swift 6 · 1.7 MB · 0.6% idle CPU · Aug 2026
